Re: Claim C-1488 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Donna Morris in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on 7-27-23. Our client
was lawfully making a left turn when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the driver's side of our
client's vehicle. The impact was significant enough to cause the airbags to deploy and to render the vehicle
undrivable from the scene.
As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a cervical neck strain and a lumbar back strain. Following the
accident, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has been undergoing a course of physical therapy,
prescribed medication, and follow-up care. Our client continues to experience stiffness, persistent pain, and
limitations in daily activities, including drviing and lifting.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured admitted at the scene that he did not see our client's vehicle before
proceeding through the intersection. Police documentation supports our client's account, and no comparative fault
can reasonably be assigned to our client.
Accordingly, we demand pamyent of $182,000.00 to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain
open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will
file suit without further notice to your company.
Expert review: Curtis James, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
Carlos Fox
Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
</page>

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
